No compared-side claim requires a complete pre-transmission inventory of Memories.

No compared-side claim addresses renewed external-sharing approval after the item set changes.

The compared frame contains no policy about recipient retention of transmitted input.
The compared frame contains no policy about internal onward disclosure by recipients.
